page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes right (two references beside the text at mid-page). Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: ab eodem profluxisse obijcis, pari omnino ratione & iure, Simonem magum, Ebionem, Cerinthum, aliaque haereticorum portenta (quae in ecclesia Apostolica à puritate doctrinae defecerunt) Apostolis ascribes. Itaque refutata accusatione tua, reliquum est, vt quae ad Romanae ecclesiae laudem proponis, expendamus.
main_text.head: COSTERVS.
main_text.p: VErvm Ecclesia Catholica, tot circumfremétibus haeresium & innumerabilium sectarum procellis, sui semper similis, stabilis ac prorsus immobilis persistit. Est enim columna & firmamentum veritatis, & à sapiente1.Tim.3.15. Matth.16.18. architecto, super firmam petram aedificata, aduersus quam portae inferi non praevalebunt. Et licet in rebus ad fidem non pertinentibus, diuersi diuersa sentiant, siue illa philosophica sint, siue Theologica: licet non vno, more instituto-que viuatur in Ecclesia Catholica (alia enim est secularium, alia Ecclesiasticorum, alia monachorum viuendi ratio) licet varij sint religioso-

page.notes: Catchword "gioso-" at foot right, read as "gioso-" (the final letter is uncertain). Marginal references "1.Tim.3.15." and "Matth.16.18." are printed in the right margin. Heading "COSTERVS." is set in spaced capitals. Some lines near the top are faint and show-through from the reverse is present; "circumfremétibus" and "Ecclesia" are read with some uncertainty. Text is printed in italic for "columna & firmamentum veritatis" and "aduersus quam portae inferi non praevalebunt".
